verdict.rationale: The documented sign-in is an account flow: the browser opens omnirush.ai/console with a device code to approve (gh-9). The app does let users add their own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys (docs-2), but the wording "also" suggests these keys sit alongside the account rather than replacing it. Missing for 10: evidence that provider keys can be used without the account/device-code login, an Omnirush-issued API key for authentication, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
